pageSubtitle: Revision diffs and the relationship between operations and evolog

revisionDiff.title: Change contents
revisionDiff.description: Shows how each change differs from its parent. Since jj auto-snapshots, you always see the latest diff.

divergentWarning.title: Divergent Change (??)
divergentWarning.description: This change ID has diverged into multiple commits.
divergentWarning.abandonHint: to discard the unwanted one, or use
divergentWarning.opRestoreHint: to restore to before the divergence.

operationEvolution.evologDescription: Evolution history of a specific change (subset of op log). Select a change to highlight the operations that affected it.
operationEvolution.selectHint: Select a change and click Load to show the relationship between op log and evolog

opLogVsEvolog.title: op log vs evolog
opLogVsEvolog.evolog: Evolution history of a specific change. Op log filtered for a single change

evologLegend.description: Evolution history of this change. Each file modification updates the commit ID (change ID remains constant).
evologLegend.opRelation: Each entry is tied to an operation (jj's operation record).
evologLegend.opLogNote: records all repository operations, but evolog filters only
